mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDPC1 indicates strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth is followed by negative 60-day returns more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 8% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 8% does not result in negative 20-day returns in over 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE indicate economic stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: The combination does not result in negative returns in over 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High FEDFUNDS during tightening cycles lead to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: High FEDFUNDS does not result in negative 60-day returns in over 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing INDPRO signals strong production, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth is followed by negative 20-day returns more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 265 indicates high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in 5 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL above 265 does not result in negative 5-day returns in over 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS but falling RSAFS indicates consumer weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: The combination does not result in negative returns in over 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing HOUST during expansion signals housing growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth is followed by negative 60-day returns more than 40% of the time.
